purpose: Rail lines whose stations count as mass transit for the ข้อ 17 500 m conditions although OpenMapTiles tags them railway=station like ordinary SRT rail (tiles carry no line names). Matched by exact English station name against subclass 'station' POIs only (never 'halt'). Pink and Yellow monorail stations are NOT listed here: they are recognised from tile geometry (station within 80 m of transit/monorail track).
